name: CommandBarComboBox
description: Represents a combo box control on a command bar.
remarks: Use Controls(_index_), where _index_ is the index number of the control, to return a CommandBarComboBox object. Note that the Type property of the control must be msoControlEdit, msoControlDropdown, msoControlComboBox, msoControlButtonDropdown, msoControlSplitDropdown, msoControlOCXDropdown, msoControlGraphicCombo, or msoControlGraphicDropdown.
example:
Set combo = CommandBars("Custom").Controls(2)
With combo
    .AddItem "First Item", 1
    .AddItem "Second Item", 2
    .DropDownLines = 3
    .DropDownWidth = 75
    .ListIndex = 0
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CommandBarComboBox object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CommandBarComboBox object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: BeginGroup
properties.description: Gets True if the specified command bar control appears at the beginning of a group of controls on the command bar. Read/write.

properties.name: BuiltIn
properties.description: Gets True if the specified command bar control is a built-in control of the container application. Returns False if it's a custom control, or if it's a built-in control whose OnAction property has been set. Read-only.

properties.name: Caption
properties.description: Gets or sets the caption text for a command bar control. Read/write.

properties.name: DescriptionText
properties.description: Gets or sets the description for a command bar combo box control. Read/write.

properties.name: Enabled
properties.description: Gets or sets a Boolean value that specifies whether the CommandBarComboBox is enabled. Read/write.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Gets or sets the height of a CommandBarComboBox control. Read/write.

properties.name: HelpContextId
properties.description: Gets or sets the Help context Id number for the Help topic attached to the CommandBarComboBox control. Read/write.

properties.name: HelpFile
properties.description: Gets or sets the file name for the Help topic attached to the CommandBarComboBox control. Read/write.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Gets the ID for a built-in CommandBarComboBox control. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Gets a Long representing the index number for a CommandBarComboBox object in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Gets the horizontal position of the CommandBarComboBox control (in pixels) relative to the left edge of the screen. Returns the distance from the left side of the docking area. Read-only.

properties.name: OLEUsage
properties.description: Gets or sets the OLE client and OLE server roles in which a CommandBarComboBox control will be used when two Microsoft Office applications are merged. Read/write.

properties.name: OnAction
properties.description: Gets or sets the name of a Visual Basic procedure that will run when the user clicks or changes the value of a CommandBarComboBox control. Read/write.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CommandBarComboBox object. Read-only.

properties.name: Parameter
properties.description: Gets or sets a string that an application can use to execute a command from a CommandBarComboBox control. Read/write.

properties.name: Priority
properties.description: Gets or sets the priority of a CommandBarComboBox control. A control's priority determines whether the control can be dropped from a docked command bar if the command bar controls can't fit in a single row. Read/write.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Gets or sets information about the CommandBarComboBox control, such as data that can be used as an argument in procedures, or information that identifies the control. Read/write.

properties.name: TooltipText
properties.description: Gets or sets the text displayed in the ScreenTip of a CommandBarComboBox. Read/write.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Gets the distance (in pixels) from the top edge of the specified CommandBarComboBox control to the top edge of the screen. Read-only.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Gets the type of CommandBarComboBox control. Read-only.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Gets or sets the Visible property for the CommandBarComboBox control. True if the CommandBarControl is visible. Read/write.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Gets or sets the width (in pixels) of the specified CommandBarComboBox control. Read/write.

properties.name: IsPriorityDropped
properties.description: Gets True if the control is currently dropped from the menu or toolbar based on usage statistics and layout space. (Note that this is not the same as the control's visibility, as set by the Visible property). Read-only.

properties.name: DropDownLines
properties.description: Gets or sets the number of lines in a command bar combo box control. The combo box control must be a custom control and it must be a drop-down list box or a combo box. Read/write.

properties.name: DropDownWidth
properties.description: Gets or sets the width (in pixels) of the list for the specified command bar combo box control. Read/write.

properties.name: List
properties.description: Gets or sets an item in the CommandBarComboBox control. Read/write.

properties.name: ListCount
properties.description: Gets the number of list items in a CommandBarComboBox control. Read-only.

properties.name: ListHeaderCount
properties.description: Gets or sets the number of list items in a CommandBarComboBox control that appears above the separator line. Read/write.

properties.name: ListIndex
properties.description: Gets or sets the index number of the selected item in the list portion of the CommandBarComboBox control. If nothing is selected in the list, this property returns zero. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Gets or sets the way a CommandBarComboBox control is displayed. Can be either of the following msoComboStyle constants: msoComboLabel or msoComboNormal. Read/write.

properties.name: Text
properties.description: Gets or sets the text in the display or edit portion of the CommandBarComboBox control. Read/write.

methods.name: Copy
methods.signature: Copy([Bar As Variant], [Before As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Copies a command bar combo box control to an existing command bar.

parameters.name: Bar
parameters.description: A CommandBar object that represents the destination command bar. If this argument is omitted, the control is copied to the command bar where the control already exists.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: A number that indicates the position for the new control on the command bar. The new control will be inserted before the control at this position. If this argument is omitted, the control is copied to the end of the command bar.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a CommandBarCombo control object from its collection.

parameters.name: Temporary
parameters.description: True to delete the control for the current session. The application will display the control again in the next session.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs the procedure or built-in command assigned to the specified CommandBarComboBox control.

methods.name: Move
methods.signature: Move([Bar As Variant], [Before As Variant]) As CommandBarControl
methods.description: Moves the specified control to an existing command bar.

parameters.name: Bar
parameters.description: A Command object that represents the destination command bar for the control. If this argument is omitted, the control is moved to the end of the command bar where the control currently resides.

parameters.name: Before
parameters.description: A number that indicates the position for the control. The control is inserted before the control currently occupying this position. If this argument is omitted, the control is inserted on the same command bar.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets a built-in command bar to its default configuration, or resets a built-in CommandBarComboBox control to its original function and face.

methods.name: SetFocus
methods.description: Moves the keyboard focus to the specified CommandBarComboBox control. If the control is disabled or isn't visible, this method will fail.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds a list item to the specified command bar combo box control. The combo box control must be a custom control and must be a drop-down list box or a combo box.

parameters.name: Text
parameters.description: The text added to the control.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The position of the item in the list. If this argument is omitted, the item is added to the end of the list.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all list items from a command bar combo box control (a drop-down list box or a combo box).

methods.name: RemoveItem
methods.description: Removes an item from a CommandBarComboBox control.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The item to be removed from the list.

events.name: Change
events.description: Occurs when the end user changes the selection in a CommandBar combo box.
